say:3:1710651002:1.text: Ha! The scabbard doesn't lie. This is the actual Excalibur!
say:3:1710651002:1.source_cn: 哈呼——剑鞘的感应不会错，这才是真正的石中剑。

say:4:1710651003:0.text: All that running around the city... and it was here the whole time.
say:4:1710651003:0.source_cn: 可恶！枉费我带着剑鞘城内城外跑了那么久，没想到它竟然被...

say:5:1710651004:1.text: Then Prince Orion was behind this. No one else could've brought it here...
say:5:1710651004:1.source_cn: 这说明一切都是奥利安王子所为了，别的人根本无权进入这里……

choice_prompt:6:1710651004.text: Then Prince Orion was behind this. No one else could've brought it here...
choice_prompt:6:1710651004.source_cn: 这说明一切都是奥利安王子所为了，别的人根本无权进入这里……

say:7:1710651005:1.text: Without the scabbard, who would've ever sniffed this out?
say:7:1710651005:1.source_cn: 要不是有剑鞘感应的话，谁能想到它在这里！

say:8:1710651006:1.text: Magister, the Excalibur symbolizes the Lightbearer throne. We can't leave it here.
say:8:1710651006:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，石中剑毕竟是象征耀光王权的剑，我们不能把它留...
say:8:1710651006:1.male: Magister, the Excalibur symbolizes the Lightbearer throne. We can't leave it here.
say:8:1710651006:1.female: Magister, the Excalibur symbolizes the Lightbearer throne. We can't leave it here.

say:9:1710651007:1.text: We must find a way to take it.
say:9:1710651007:1.source_cn: 无论如何，得想办法带走它。

choice_prompt:10:1710651007.text: We must find a way to take it.
choice_prompt:10:1710651007.source_cn: 无论如何，得想办法带走它。

say:11:1710651008:1.text: The sword doesn't move. It coldly rejects your attempt.
say:11:1710651008:1.source_cn: 石中剑纹丝不动，冰冷地拒绝了你的临时起意。
say:11:1710651008:1.male: The sword doesn't move. It coldly rejects your attempt.
say:11:1710651008:1.female: The sword doesn't move. It coldly rejects your attempt.

say:13:1710651009:0.text: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?
say:13:1710651009:0.source_cn: 呜哇！看不出来你也对耀光王位感兴趣！
say:13:1710651009:0.male: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?
say:13:1710651009:0.female: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?

choice_prompt:14:1710651009.text: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?
choice_prompt:14:1710651009.source_cn: 呜哇！看不出来你也对耀光王位感兴趣！
choice_prompt:14:1710651009.male: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?
choice_prompt:14:1710651009.female: Whoa! Getting ideas about the crown?

say:15:1710651010:1.text: See? This is the genuine Excalibur!
say:15:1710651010:1.source_cn: 这下你相信了吧，这可是货真价实的石中剑！
say:15:1710651010:1.male: See? This is the genuine Excalibur!
say:15:1710651010:1.female: See? This is the genuine Excalibur!

say:16:1710651012:1.text: Imagine, though. If you had pulled it out, would the King step down? He's not ruling anyway.
say:16:1710651012:1.source_cn: 不敢想象……如果刚刚你把剑拔出来了，国王是不是该让位给...
say:16:1710651012:1.male: Imagine, though. If you had pulled it out, would the King step down? He's not ruling anyway.
say:16:1710651012:1.female: Imagine, though. If you had pulled it out, would the King step down? He's not ruling anyway.

say:17:1710651013:1.text: What would we call you? His Majesty? Supreme Magister and King of the Lightbearer Empire?
say:17:1710651013:1.source_cn: 到那个时候，该叫你什么呢？梅林大帝？耀光帝国国王兼魔法...
say:17:1710651013:1.male: What would we call you? His Majesty? Supreme Magister and King of the Lightbearer Empire?
say:17:1710651013:1.female: What would we call you? Her Majesty? Supreme Magister and Queen of the Lightbearer Empire?

say:18:1710651014:0.source_cn: 嘘，小狐狸，这样的话可不能随便说！

say:19:1710651015:1.text: Relax, relax. We're the only ones here anyway!
say:19:1710651015:1.source_cn: 我知道的啦，反正这儿只有我们几个！

say:20:1710651016:0.text: Well, we can't pull it out. Let's think of another plan.
say:20:1710651016:0.source_cn: 想拔出剑带走肯定是行不通了，再想想别的办法吧。

choice_prompt:21:1710651016.text: Well, we can't pull it out. Let's think of another plan.
choice_prompt:21:1710651016.source_cn: 想拔出剑带走肯定是行不通了，再想想别的办法吧。

say:23:1710651017:0.text: You extend your hand. The air around the sword begins to warp and fold.
say:23:1710651017:0.source_cn: 你伸出手，释放了特殊的空间魔法。
say:23:1710651017:0.male: You extend your hand. The air around the sword begins to warp and fold.
say:23:1710651017:0.female: You extend your hand. The air around the sword begins to warp and fold.

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 只是想验证一下石中剑的真伪

say:25:1710651011:1.text: Well, didn't look like it fit you.
say:25:1710651011:1.source_cn: 哦，原来是这样吗？看起来你用着不是很顺手呢。
say:25:1710651011:1.male: Well, didn't look like it fit you.
say:25:1710651011:1.female: Well, didn't look like it fit you.

choice:14:1:2.text: I just wanted to feel it in my hands.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 只是想感受一下石中剑的手感
choice:14:1:2.male: I just wanted to feel it in my hands.
choice:14:1:2.female: I just wanted to feel it in my hands.

choice:10:0:1.text: (Grip the hilt and pull with all your strength)
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: （用尽全力试着将剑从基石中拔出）
choice:10:0:1.male: (Grip the hilt and pull with all your strength)
choice:10:0:1.female: (Grip the hilt and pull with all your strength)

choice:6:0:1.text: He must've thought it was safe here.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 奥利安觉得这里是最安全的地方
choice:6:0:1.male: He must've thought it was safe here.
choice:6:0:1.female: He must've thought it was safe here.

choice:6:1:2.text: It was hidden in plain sight.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 越不起眼的地方越不会被怀疑
choice:6:1:2.male: It was hidden in plain sight.
choice:6:1:2.female: It was hidden in plain sight.
